light: This is one ordinary frame pulled from a normal handheld video shot by a kitchen helper with a consumer camera at eye level, simply recording what happens, not composing a photo. The framing is casual and a little off: something is cut by the edge of the frame. Almost everything in the frame is in focus, nothing blurred out: the kitchen behind stays fully readable. The only light is what the place really has, correctly exposed, morning daylight from a side window. Colours of an ordinary video with automatic white balance and almost no correction: moderate contrast, natural saturation, soft highlights, mild sensor noise and light compression, faint motion blur on anything moving. Skin with pores and uneven tone; the cotton shirt and apron with real creases; real food with real texture. People are caught mid-action, unposed.
look: Ordinary handheld video filmed by a kitchen helper with a consumer camera at eye level, small natural shakes and casual slightly imperfect framing, everything in the kitchen in focus, only the light the place really has, correctly exposed, automatic white balance, natural colors, mild sensor noise; real skin and natural working hands; real food, steam rising up; he moves naturally and unposed, nothing staged; no music.

anchors.prompt: The first image is the place; the second image shows Claudio and exactly how he is dressed. In the kitchen of an old small family-run fonda in a Mexican town: whitewashed walls, blue-and-white talavera tiles, copper and clay pots hanging from hooks, at the old white 4-burner gas stove with worn chipped enamel against blue-and-white talavera tiles; on the stove the big black cast-iron comal, smooth and shiny from decades of use, flat and round with no handle, and the big reddish clay olla de barro with two handles and a clay lid; wooden spoons standing in a clay jar; copper pots hanging on the whitewashed wall. Claudio, a Latin American cook about 50 with dark curly hair streaked with gray and a short graying beard, warm brown eyes, tanned brown skin with laugh lines, working hands, wearing a light sky-blue long-sleeve cotton shirt with the sleeves rolled to the elbow, a white cotton apron with old faded chile and grease stains, and a red-and-white checkered kitchen towel over his RIGHT shoulder stands at the old white gas stove; on the front burner the big reddish clay olla de barro with two handles uncovered, raw seasoned pork ribs arranged inside in an even layer; on the counter a bowl of dark red chile sauce and the glass blender jar with a little water. Seen from a kitchen helper's handheld camera at eye level, framed from the knees or waist up, the place exactly as in the first image. He wears the same sky-blue shirt with rolled sleeves, the same stained white apron and the same red-and-white checkered towel over his right shoulder the whole time, same curly gray-streaked hair and short graying beard, same face as the reference.

clips.text: Ahora, a la olla. Acomodo las costillas, parejitas, con el hueso para arriba si caben. Encima la salsa, y la taza de agua para enjuagar la licuadora y no desperdiciar nada.
clips.action: Claudio, the man whose face is the third reference image, pours the bowl of dark red sauce over the ribs in the olla, then the water from the blender jar. morning daylight from a side window. He wears the same sky-blue shirt with rolled sleeves, the same stained white apron and the same red-and-white checkered towel over his right shoulder the whole time, same curly gray-streaked hair and short graying beard, same face as the reference.

clips.text: Fíjate dónde queda el líquido. A la mitad de las costillas. No las cubre. Si te queda más bajo, un chorrito más de agua, pero no las ahogues. Tapo la olla.
clips.action: Claudio, the man whose face is the third reference image, points with his finger at the line of the sauce halfway up the ribs, then puts the clay lid on. morning daylight from a side window. He wears the same sky-blue shirt with rolled sleeves, the same stained white apron and the same red-and-white checkered towel over his right shoulder the whole time, same curly gray-streaked hair and short graying beard, same face as the reference.

clips.text: Y fuego bajo. Que burbujee despacito, una burbuja aquí, otra allá.
clips.action: Claudio, the man whose face is the third reference image, turns the knob down to a small low blue flame. morning daylight from a side window.
